nuggets.text: Saturday is the Sooners' first game ever at Michigan Stadium, which holds more than 107,000 fans.
The Sooners beat Michigan 14-6 in the 1976 Orange Bowl to clinch Barry Switzer's second straight national title.
The Sooners are 2-0 all-time against Michigan, including a 24-13 win in Norman last season.
The Sooners scored on their first eight possessions in a 51-0 opening win over UTEP.
Isaiah Sategna III returned a punt 88 yards for a touchdown in the Sooners' 51-0 opener against UTEP.
Sooners QB John Mateer followed his offensive coordinator, Ben Arbuckle, from Washington State to Oklahoma.
Sooners coach Brent Venables was Oklahoma's co-defensive coordinator on its 2000 national championship team.
The Sooners' 47-game winning streak is still the record; no FBS team has topped 35 straight wins since.
The Sooner Schooner, a wagon pulled by white ponies named Boomer and Sooner, first rolled out in 1964 against USC.
In the 1985 Orange Bowl, the Sooner Schooner rolled out to celebrate a field goal wiped out by a penalty and drew a 15-yard flag.
